title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode6 Unruly Bunch

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: The day of the event
Elementary School - Gym

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're looking forward to putting on a great event with all of you today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're still novice storytellers, but we promise to do everything we can to make sure all the children go home smiling today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line:
Likewise!
You both really saved the day by agreeing to do this.

rows.Speaker: Association Executive A
rows.Line: We heard that you've prepared a number of effects. We're really looking forward to seeing them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, we promise to do our best!

rows.Speaker: Association Executive A
rows.Line: Wonderful! Anyway, we'll see you two again a little later.
se_walk_women_005_4

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was a little worried that I'd be overstepping since I'm an outsider...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they all seem really happy to have me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're very grateful for you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, time really flew by while preparing for this event. I can't believe it's already the day of.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me neither. I'm actually feeling a little more nervous than I usually do before I go out and perform.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I asked quite a lot of people for their help, and I did everything I could to prepare for this event, but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Will I manage to do this story justice?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, the children should be arriving soon...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're right.
Why don't we make sure all the equipment works one last time?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, I'll check the stuff over by the stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll see you again in a bit.
se_walk_women_005_1
<Sounds like it's almost showtime, Honami.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: MEIKO...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I'm sorry if I startled you.
But I wanted to tell you something before your reading.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Tell me something...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes. I actually watched your rehearsal yesterday in secret.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You two were so good that you had me on the edge of my seat the whole time!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was a little worried that the children wouldn't enjoy the way we present this story...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I feel much better after hearing you say that you liked what you saw, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As with any live performance, it's normal to have a lot of things go through your mind...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Chiefly, whether or not all the hard work you put in is going to pay off.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<But I'm sure you two will do just fine.
So, go out there and have as much fun as the children are about to.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'll do just that, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll find a good spot by the stage for my phone, so please stay and watch if you like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you! I'll be rooting for you.>
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The people at registration seem to be done. I guess that's everyone?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we'll probably be introducing ourselves very soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's do our best today, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta make the most of all the hard work we put in.

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Alright, it's time for today's fun and fantastic reading event to begin.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yay! What do you think they're gonna read today?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: I dunno, but I'm really excited...!

rows.Speaker: Association Chair
rows.Line: Today, these two lovely ladies will be your storytellers.
se_walk_women_005_2
se_walk_women_005_3

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
We hope you're looking forward to today's story.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Huh? Where's our usual storyteller?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're sorry about that.
But we promise to do our best today so that you all have fun.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Umm...
Would you all mind sitting down in front of the stage for us?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: I'm gonna be first!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! I wanna be first!

rows.Speaker: Association Executive B
rows.Line:
Cut it out, you two.
There's plenty of space for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, can you kids also...?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Tag! Hehe. You're it!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Hey, wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
Stop running around and come over by the sta—
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Heehee. Catch me if you can!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Haha. Too slow!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They're too fast...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Phew...
They finally agreed to sit... Wait—

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Cool, we did it!
Hey, you guys! Let's play up here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did he get on stage?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but we need to use the stage when telling the story, so could you come back down?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: No!

rows.Speaker: Association Executive A
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
They're usually a little less rambunctious than this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They are?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Well, duh! Our usual storyteller isn't here!
And these two look like wimps.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: They're super slow, too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What was that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: K-Kusanagi...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I know...
They're just kids being kids.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everybody, come on down here...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We don't wanna!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You little...

rows.Speaker: Association Executive B
rows.Line: Hey, you children need to listen to them!

rows.Speaker: Association Executive A
rows.Line: Otherwise, you won't be getting any snacks later.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Grr... Fine...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure we're gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little less certain now...
